terms.definition_en: The capability of computer systems to perform tasks that require human intelligence, such as learning from patterns and making decisions.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Computer systems ki salahiyat ke leye insani zehanat ki zaroorat hone wale kaam anjam dene ki, jaise patterns se sikhna aur faisle lena.

terms.definition_en: A step-by-step procedure or formula for solving a problem or accomplishing a task.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Masla hal karne ya kaam anjam dene ke leye qadam-dar-qadam tareeka ya formula.

terms.definition_en: The ability to identify recurring structures or regularities in data.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Data mein dubara hone wali sarakht ya niyamitata ko pehchanane ki salahiyat.

terms.definition_en: A subset of AI where systems learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed.
terms.definition_roman_ur: AI ka ek hissa jahan systems tajarbay se sikhte aur behtar hote hain bina spashtata se program kiye hue.

terms.definition_en: A computing system inspired by biological neural networks that constitute animal brains.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Biological neural networks se ilham hasil karke banaya gaya computing system jo janwaron ke dimaagon ko banta hai.

terms.definition_en: A subset of machine learning using multiple layers of artificial neural networks.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Machine learning ka ek hissa jo masnooi neural networks ki kayi tahezon ka istemaal karta hai.

terms.definition_en: The dataset used to train a machine learning model to recognize patterns.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Patterns ko pehchanane ke leye machine learning model ko sakhayati dene mein istemaal hone wala dataset.

terms.definition_en: A mathematical representation of learned patterns from training data.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Training data se seekhe gaye patterns ka ek mathematical representation.

terms.definition_en: AI systems that can create new, original content such as text, images, or code.
terms.definition_roman_ur: AI systems jo naya, asal content bana sakte hain jaise text, images, ya code.

terms.definition_en: A neural network model trained on massive amounts of text data to understand and generate human language.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Ek neural network model jo insani zaban ko samjhne aur produce karne ke leye bhari matra mein text data par sakhayati diya gaya.

terms.definition_en: A neural network architecture that uses attention mechanisms to process sequences of data.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Ek neural network architecture jo data ke sequences ko process karne ke leye attention mechanisms ka istemaal karta hai.

terms.definition_en: A small unit of text, often a word or part of a word, that an AI model processes.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Text ka ek chhota unit, aksar ek lafz ya lafz ka ek hissa, jo AI model process karta hai.

terms.definition_en: An input or instruction given to an AI model to generate a desired output.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Ek input ya instruction jo required output produce karne ke leye AI model ko diya jaata hai.

terms.definition_en: A technique that retrieves relevant information from a database and uses it to enhance AI-generated responses.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Ek technique jo database se relevant information retrieve karta hai aur isko AI-generated responses ko behtar banana ke leye istemaal karta hai.

terms.definition_en: When an AI model generates incorrect or fabricated information.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Jab AI model galat ya banaya gaya information produce karta hai.

terms.definition_en: Numerical representations of words or concepts that capture their semantic meaning.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Lafzon ya concepts ki numerical representation jo un ke semantic meaning ko pakde.

terms.definition_en: A technique that allows neural networks to focus on the most relevant parts of input data.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Ek technique jo neural networks ko input data ke sabse relevant parts par focus karne ki ijazat deta hai.

terms.definition_en: Learnable variables in a neural network that are adjusted during training.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Neural network mein seekhne hone wale variables jo training mein adjust kiye jaate hain.

terms.definition_en: Complete passes through the entire training dataset during model training.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Model training mein poore training dataset se complete pass karna.

terms.definition_en: A mathematical function that measures how far a model's predictions are from the actual data.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Ek mathematical function jo model ke predictions ko actual data se kitni door hain ye measure karta hai.
